title: Artesian Wells Image Gallery
text: vignette provides visual showcase artesian wells documented dataset. images organized district displayed alongside key information well site.
code: # Prepare data with image URLs wells_with_images <- artesianwells %>%   filter(!is.na(well_images)) %>%   mutate(     # Extract first image URL if multiple are separated by semicolons     first_well_image = str_extract(well_images, "^[^;]+"),     first_area_photo = if_else(!is.na(area_photos),                                 str_extract(area_photos, "^[^;]+"),                                 NA_character_)   ) %>%   select(     district,     traditional_authority,     latitude,     longitude,     has_structure,     well_structure_type,     seconds_to_fill_20L,     use_of_site,     river_nearby,     has_operator,     mgmt_type,     first_well_image,     first_area_photo   )  # Count wells by district district_summary <- wells_with_images %>%   group_by(district) %>%   summarise(     well_count = n(),     avg_fill_time = round(mean(seconds_to_fill_20L, na.rm = TRUE), 1),     .groups = "drop"   ) %>%   arrange(desc(well_count))

title: Artesian Wells Image Gallery
text: dataset contains images 43 artesian well sites across 10 districts Malawi. Table 1: Summary artesian wells district
code: district_summary %>%   gt() %>%   cols_label(     district = "District",     well_count = "Number of Wells",     avg_fill_time = "Avg. Fill Time (seconds)"   ) %>%   tab_header(     title = "Artesian Wells Distribution",     subtitle = "Wells with documented images"   ) %>%   fmt_number(     columns = avg_fill_time,     decimals = 1   ) %>%   tab_style(     style = cell_fill(color = "lightblue"),     locations = cells_body(columns = well_count, rows = well_count > 5)   )

title: Artesian Wells Image Gallery
text: quick visual overview, ’s grid displaying well images organized rows 4: Figure 1: Distribution artesian wells primary use Table 2: Flow rate statistics district Images hosted mwater API may require internet connection display wells multiple images; first image displayed gallery Flow rate data available wells dataset collected April 2024
code: wells_with_images %>%   count(use_of_site) %>%   mutate(use_of_site = fct_reorder(use_of_site, n)) %>%   ggplot(aes(x = n, y = use_of_site, fill = use_of_site)) +   geom_col() +   geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2) +   scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +   labs(     x = "Number of Wells",     y = "Primary Use",     title = "Primary Usage of Artesian Wells"   ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.position = "none") wells_with_images %>%   filter(!is.na(seconds_to_fill_20L)) %>%   group_by(district) %>%   summarise(     n_tested = n(),     min_time = min(seconds_to_fill_20L, na.rm = TRUE),     avg_time = mean(seconds_to_fill_20L, na.rm = TRUE),     max_time = max(seconds_to_fill_20L, na.rm = TRUE),     .groups = "drop"   ) %>%   gt() %>%   cols_label(     district = "District",     n_tested = "Wells Tested",     min_time = "Min (s)",     avg_time = "Average (s)",     max_time = "Max (s)"   ) %>%   fmt_number(     columns = c(min_time, avg_time, max_time),     decimals = 1   ) %>%   tab_header(     title = "Flow Rate Statistics",     subtitle = "Time to fill 20-liter container"   ) %>%   data_color(     columns = avg_time,     colors = scales::col_numeric(       palette = c("green", "yellow", "red"),       domain = NULL     )   )

title: Artesian Well Site Assessment Data
text: Description dataset provides detailed information artesian well sites located Zomba, Blantyre, Mangochi, Thyolo, Lilongwe, Dowa, Balaka, Mwanza, Neno Chiradzulo, collected April 2024. record represents unique well site includes attributes related location (latitude longitude), water source characteristics, infrastructure details, site usage, environmental context, management structures. Key variables Geolocation: Coordinates map analyze spatial distribution. Water source information: Whether well artesian, presence structures, ability test flow, time (seconds) fill 20-liter container. Usage patterns: Main additional uses site (e.g., domestic, irrigation, fish farming). Nearby water abstractions: Proximity attributes neighboring abstraction points. Environmental data: Seasonal availability nearby river presence. dataset complemented images captured site, accessible via permanent URLs, provide photographic evidence physical infrastructural conditions.

title: Artesian Well Site Assessment Data

Hydrological Environmental Studies Researchers environmental scientists can analyze recharge patterns, abstraction pressures, seasonal availability groundwater sustainability assessments. Infrastructure Development Maintenance Engineers local authorities can use structure type condition data prioritize maintenance investments water infrastructure. Community Health Livelihood Planning dataset helps evaluate adequacy water sources domestic agricultural use, critical public health economic planning. Geospatial GIS Mapping Projects detailed coordinates associated metadata support mapping efforts visualize analyze spatial patterns water accessibility site clustering. Monitoring Evaluation (M&E) Organizations implementing rural water programs can track improvements, assess usage efficiency, monitor infrastructure time.

code: library(artesianwells) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(maps) # Filter usable water point locations water_map_data <- artesianwells %>%   filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude))  # Ensure geo-points are valid  # Get Malawi map outline malawi_map <- map_data("world", region = "Malawi")  # Plot the water point locations ggplot() +   geom_polygon(data = malawi_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),                fill = "gray90", color = "gray70") +   geom_point(data = water_map_data,              aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = use_of_site),              size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +   coord_fixed(1.3) +   labs(     title = "Artesian Wells in Malawi",     x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Use of Water Site"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")
